import bisect

def solve(nums1, nums2):
    nums1.sort()
    h1 = sorted(nums2)
    result = []
    for num in nums1:
        idx = bisect.bisect_left(h1, num)
        if idx < len(h1) and h1[idx] == num:
            result.append(num)
            h1.pop(idx)
    return result
